stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Sunray Engineering Group Limited delivers comprehensive building protection solutions throughout Hong Kong and Macau. The firm provides a diverse range of products, specifically for waterproofing, tiling, and flooring, which are utilized in both residential and commercial properties. Its offerings also extend to various public and private sector community facilities, such as sports complexes, theaters, medical institutions, power generation stations, and other public amenities. Established in 1988, the company maintains its principal base in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong.
